notes.title: [Update] 90fps + Hand Tracking Improvement + Chinese support
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38210973/89ed7837b0fa6d555085041fc88cfbc60a1ccfa8.png[/img]

We have good news for Quest 2 users!

Pedro and Rosa's heartwarming story can now be enjoyed with an enhanced experience.
• Quest 2 frame rate and resolution optimizations:
The game now runs at 90fps and 1.3x native resolution on this device.

• The game now uses “High Frequency Hand Tracking” mode on Quest 2, increasing tracking rate to 60hz

• Chinese Interface, subtitles, and Full Audio available

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38210973/c8de32502876698da182c1a96b5a14d0af56a00c.gif[/img]

🌻

notes.title: “The Line” Wins Primetime Emmy® Award!
notes.notes:
“The Line” has been awarded a Primetime Emmy® for “Outstanding Innovation in Interactive Programming”. In addition to its innovative storytelling language,  “The Line” is the first narrative experience to integrate Oculus Quest’s hand tracking technology.

[previewyoutube=UYWjPOgtOFo;full][/previewyoutube]
